rationale: Manual override by the code owner (Dmytro Melnyk). CR-001 is a false positive: iter_key cannot be None in continue_iteration because it is validated upstream (the graph builder only wires continue_iteration when iter_key is truthy), so the AttributeError cannot be raised. The sibling candidate (dict value at iter_key is None) was dismissed as non-blocking. The negative JSON-pointer index wrap is pre-existing, unmodified code outside this ticket's scope and is deferred (see code-review-deferred.md).

findings.title: Unhandled AttributeError when iter_key is None
findings.problem: In continue_iteration, when iter_key is None (or any non-string), `iter_key.startswith('/')` raises AttributeError, which is not caught by the surrounding `except (KeyError, ValueError)` clause.
findings.impact: Not reachable: iter_key is validated upstream and continue_iteration is only wired when iter_key is truthy.
